title: 第2章 荒滩血战倭奴逞凶 孤子泣血承遗命

第(1/3)页

晚明：龙起海疆第二章

滩涂的淤泥被急促的脚步声搅得浑浊，十三名倭寇踩着刚退潮的湿土，像饿狼般朝着林驰等人逃窜的方向追来。他们足蹬无跟的粗麻鞋，踩在泥泞里竟不显滞涩，窄袖短袄下的身躯虽不算高大，却透着一股常年劫掠养成的凶戾之气。为首的倭寇留着半月形的发髻，脸上一道狰狞的刀疤从眉骨延伸到下颌，手里握着一柄磨得发亮的武士短刀，刀尖上还沾着不知是谁的血迹。

“快！再快点！”林驰咬着牙，拽着毛豆的胳膊往前冲。毛豆的小脸憋得通红，两条细腿几乎跟不上众人的步伐，呼吸急促得像破旧的风箱，每跑一步都要踉跄一下。身后的倭寇越追越近，粗重的喘息声、叽里呱啦的呼喊声，还有刀刃摩擦鞘口的声响，像催命的鼓点敲在每个人的心上。

林驰心里清楚，他们这些半大孩子，平日里连顿饱饭都吃不上，面黄肌瘦的，哪有什么体力？反观那些倭寇，虽也是散兵游勇，却常年在海上劫掠，身手矫健，耐力惊人。若非借着对滩涂地形的熟悉，专挑淤泥深厚、坑洼遍布的地方跑，恐怕早就被追上了。

“阿驰哥，我……我跑不动了……”毛豆的声音带着哭腔，双腿一软，差点摔倒在地。林驰急忙回身扶住他，刚想催促，就听见身后传来“咻咻”的箭矢破空声。

“低头！快低头！”林驰猛地将毛豆按倒在地，一支羽箭擦着他的头顶飞过，钉在不远处的芦苇秆上，箭尾还在嗡嗡作响。

倭寇们停下脚步，纷纷取下背上的倭弓，拉弓搭箭。他们脸上带着戏谑的笑容，互相用生硬的汉话和倭语吆喝着，像是在进行一场狩猎游戏。“看我的！射中那个最小的！”一个留着络腮胡的倭寇咧嘴一笑，露出焦黄的牙齿，弓弦一松，羽箭直直射向毛豆。

林驰瞳孔骤缩，一把将毛豆往旁边一推，羽箭擦着毛豆的胳膊飞过，在他的衣袖上划开一道长长的口子，鲜血立刻渗了出来。“狗子！你跑得快，赶紧回卫所报信！就说倭寇来了，让我爹带人快来！”林驰嘶吼着，声音因为极度的紧张而有些变调。

狗子愣了一下，看着越来越近的倭寇，又看了看林驰和毛豆，眼眶一红，转身就往村落的方向狂奔。“阿驰哥！你撑住！我马上就带人来！”他的声音在风中飘散，身影很快消失在芦苇丛中。

倭寇见有人跑了，也不追赶，反而越发兴奋。“哈哈，跑了一个小的，正好专心射这两个！”刀疤脸倭寇狞笑着，连续射出两支羽箭。林驰拉着毛豆拼命躲闪，脚下的淤泥却像沼泽一样，死死拽着他们的脚步。就在这时，毛豆突然“啊”的一声惨叫，身体猛地一顿，往前踉跄了几步，重重地摔在泥泞里。

林驰回头一看，只见一支羽箭深深插进了毛豆的后背，箭杆还在微微颤抖，鲜血顺着箭杆汩汩流出，很快染红了身下的淤泥。“毛豆！”林驰目眦欲裂，不顾一切地扑过去，将毛豆从泥里抱起来。毛豆的小脸煞白，嘴唇发紫，气息微弱，看着林驰，艰难地吐出几个字：“阿驰哥……我……我好冷……”

“别怕！我带你走！我带你回家！”林驰强忍着眼泪，将毛豆背到背上，双手紧紧托住他的大腿，转身继续往前跑。背上的重量陡然增加，加上毛豆的鲜血顺着后背往下流，浸透了他的短褐，林驰只觉得浑身发软，每跑一步都像是在透支生命。

倭寇见射中了人，发出一阵嚣张的哄笑，脚步也加快了几分。“吆西，跑不快了”“谁先射中那个背着人的，今晚就多喝一壶酒！”他们一边追，一边不断拉弓放箭，那倭弓曲臂短拉，射速又快了一分，羽箭像雨点一样落在林驰周围，有的钉在淤泥里，有的擦着他的肩膀飞过，险象环生。

林驰低着头，凭借着对地形的熟悉，在芦苇丛和土坡之间穿梭。他能感觉到背上的毛豆身体越来越沉，气息也越来越微弱，心里像被刀割一样疼。他知道，自己必须坚持住，必须把毛豆带出去，必须等到父亲他们来救援。

就在林驰快要支撑不住的时候，远处突然传来一阵杂乱的脚步声和呼喊声。“倭寇在哪里？！”“保护百姓！”林驰心中一喜，抬头望去，只见不远处的土坡上，父亲林续正带领着二十多个卫所军户冲了过来。他们大多穿着破旧的军袄，手里拿着各式各样的武器，有锈迹斑斑的长刀，有木头削成的长枪，还有几个人手里握着明军制式弓，脸上满是焦急之色。

“爹！这里！”林驰用尽全身力气大喊一声。

Late Ming Dynasty: Dragon Rising from the Sea Chapter 2

The mud on the beach was muddied by the rapid footsteps. Thirteen Japanese pirates stepped on the wet soil that had just receded, chasing like hungry wolves in the direction where Lin Chi and others were fleeing.They wore burlap shoes without heels, which made them not feel sluggish when they stepped in the mud. Although their bodies under the narrow-sleeved short coats were not tall, they exuded a ferocious aura developed from years of plunder.The leader of the Japanese pirates had a half-moon-shaped bun, and a ferocious scar on his face extending from his brow bone to his chin. He held a brightly polished samurai short sword in his hand, and the tip of the sword was stained with the blood of an unknown person.

"Hurry! Hurry up!" Lin Chi gritted his teeth and grabbed Maodou's arm and rushed forward.Maodou's little face was red from suppressing the pain, his thin legs could hardly keep up with the pace of the crowd, his breathing was as fast as an old bellows, and he stumbled every step he took.The Japanese pirates behind them were chasing closer and closer. The sound of heavy breathing, squeaking shouts, and the sound of the blade rubbing against the sheath mouth was like a drumbeat beating on everyone's heart.

Lin Chi knew in his heart that half-grown children like them could not even eat a full meal on weekdays. They were sallow and skinny, so how could they have any physical strength?On the other hand, the Japanese pirates, although they were stragglers, had been plundering at sea all year round. They were very strong and had amazing endurance.If he hadn't used his familiarity with the terrain of the tidal flats and specifically chosen places with deep mud and lots of potholes to run, he would have been overtaken long ago.

"Brother Achi, I...I can't run anymore..." Maodou's voice sounded like crying. His legs went weak and he almost fell to the ground.Lin Chi hurriedly turned around to support him. Just as he was about to urge him, he heard the sound of arrows piercing the air behind him.

"Lower your head! Lower your head quickly!" Lin Chi pushed Maodou to the ground violently, and an arrow flew over his head and was nailed to a reed stalk not far away. The tail of the arrow was still buzzing.

The Japanese pirates stopped, took off the Japanese bows on their backs, drew their bows and set arrows.With joking smiles on their faces, they yelled at each other in blunt Chinese and Japanese, as if they were engaging in a hunting game."Look at me! Shoot the smallest one!" A Japanese pirate with a beard grinned, showing his scorched yellow teeth, loosened his bowstring, and shot his arrow straight at Maodou.

Lin Chi's pupils shrank suddenly and he pushed Maodou aside. The arrow flew past Maodou's arm and opened a long gash on his sleeve, and blood immediately seeped out."Gouzi! You run fast and report back to the guard station! Just say that the Japanese pirates are coming and ask my father to bring someone here quickly!" Lin Chi roared, his voice slightly changed due to extreme nervousness.

Gouzi was stunned for a moment, looking at the Japanese pirates who were getting closer and closer, then at Lin Chi and Maodou, his eyes turned red, and he turned around and ran towards the village."Brother Achi! Hold on! I'll bring someone here right away!" His voice drifted in the wind, and his figure quickly disappeared among the reeds.

When the Japanese pirates saw someone running away, they did not chase them, but became more and more excited."Haha, a little one ran away, so I happened to focus on shooting these two!" The scar-faced Japanese pirate smiled ferociously and shot two feather arrows in succession.Lin Chi pulled Maodou to dodge desperately, but the mud under their feet was like a swamp, dragging their feet tightly.At this moment, Maodou suddenly screamed "Ah", his body suddenly froze, he stumbled forward a few steps, and fell heavily into the mud.

Lin Chi looked back and saw an arrow deeply inserted into Maodou's back. The arrow shaft was still trembling slightly. Blood gurgled down the arrow shaft and soon dyed the mud underneath him red."Edamame!" Lin Chi's eyes were splitting as he rushed over desperately and picked up the edamame from the mud.Maodou's little face was pale, his lips were purple, and his breath was weak. He looked at Lin Chi and struggled to say a few words: "Brother Achi... I... I'm so cold..."

"Don't be afraid! I'll take you away! I'll take you home!" Lin Chi held back tears, carried Maodou on his back, held his thighs tightly with both hands, turned around and continued running forward.The weight on his back suddenly increased, and the blood of edamame flowed down his back, soaking into his short hair. Lin Chi felt that his whole body was weak, and every step he took seemed to be draining his life.

When the Japanese pirates saw that they had hit someone, they burst into arrogant laughter and their pace quickened a bit."Xinxi, I can't run any faster." "Whoever shoots the one carrying the man first will drink an extra bottle of wine tonight!" As they chased, they kept drawing their bows and firing arrows. The Japanese bow's curved arm was shortened and the shooting speed was one minute faster. The arrows fell around Lin Chi like raindrops. Some were nailed in the mud, and some flew past his shoulders. Danger was everywhere.

Lin Chi lowered his head and relied on his familiarity with the terrain to shuttle between the reeds and soil slopes.He could feel the edamame on his back getting heavier and heavier, his breath getting weaker and weaker, and his heart hurt like a knife.He knew that he had to hold on, he had to take Maodou out, and he had to wait until his father and the others came to rescue him.

Just when Lin Chi was about to lose his support, a burst of chaotic footsteps and shouts suddenly came from the distance."Where are the Japanese pirates?!" "Protect the people!" Lin Chi was delighted. He looked up and saw his father, Lin Xuzheng, leading more than 20 guardsmen rushing over on the slope not far away.Most of them were wearing shabby military jackets, holding various weapons in their hands, including rusty long knives, long spears made of wood, and a few of them were holding Ming army standard bows, with anxious looks on their faces.

"Dad! Here!" Lin Chi shouted with all his strength.
